subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned Barnacle PR-limit notice remain open now that the 20-PR cap is documented and enforced?
rationale: The code and docs are already shipped, but a maintainer reopened and pinned the issue after that fix, so the remaining choice is announcement lifecycle rather than source implementation.

options.title: Keep the pinned notice open
options.body: Preserves the visible queue-policy announcement for contributors while source enforcement and docs remain the durable contract.

options.title: Close as implemented
options.body: Treat the shipped docs and automation as sufficient and remove the issue from the open queue.

options.title: Move to a docs/discussion pointer
options.body: Replace the pinned issue with a maintainer-authored docs or discussion link and close the issue after that public handoff exists.

recommendation.title: Keep the pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Preserves the visible queue-policy announcement for contributors while source enforcement and docs remain the durable contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They renamed, pinned, and reopened the notice after the implementation path had already closed it.
